basis: One individual's concessional and non-concessional contributions caps for an income year under ITAA 1997 ss 291-20 and 292-85 (compilation 268, 1 October 2026), with the unused concessional cap carried forward year by year from 2018-19.

concessional_caps.basis: ITAA 1997 s 291-20(2): $25,000 for 2017-18, indexed annually under Subdivision 960-M (s 960-285). Amounts are the ATO's Table 1.1 on its contributions caps page.

carry_forward.basis: ITAA 1997 s 291-20(3) to (7): when the year's concessional contributions would exceed its cap and the total superannuation balance just before the year is less than $500,000, the previously unapplied unused cap of the previous 5 years increases the cap, earliest year first, by no more than the excess. A year's unused cap is its shortfall below its cap, and there is none for a year before 2018-19.

non_concessional.basis: ITAA 1997 s 292-85(2): 4 times the s 291-20(2) cap, or nil when the total superannuation balance immediately before the year equals or exceeds the general transfer balance cap. s 292-85(3) to (5): in a first year of bring forward, twice or 3 times that cap, by the first year cap space. s 292-90(1)(b): excess concessional contributions count.
non_concessional.transfer_balance_cap_basis: ATO Table 26, General transfer balance cap (ITAA 1997 s 294-35(3): $1,600,000 for 2017-18, indexed annually).

limits: Preparation aid requiring professional review; it does not decide what to contribute, issue a determination or work out the tax on an excess.

Every amount and fact is caller-supplied: which contributions are concessional (s 291-25) or non-concessional (s 292-90), each total superannuation balance, the age test and whether an earlier bring forward covers the year are not verified.

Defined benefit interests (Subdivision 291-C), interests in a constitutionally protected fund, a second or third year of bring forward (s 292-85(6) and (7)) and a release of excess concessional contributions (s 292-90(1A)) are refused.

Contributions count in the year the fund receives them; the calculator does not allocate contributions between years, apply a reallocation or disregard decision, or count the CGT cap, downsizer or other excluded contributions.
